title: The Red Sox just did something the team hasn’t accomplished since 1912
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: The Boston Red Sox clinched their ninth consecutive series win with a 4-0 victory over the White Sox.
This series win streak is the second-longest in Red Sox history, with the 1912 team holding the record.
The Red Sox are now 30-5 since late June after starting the season with a 32-46 record.

title: Alleged fugitive arson suspect from Mass. nabbed in Conn. after 100-mph chase
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Mark Alicea, 39, was arrested in Enfield, CT, for allegedly stealing a car and leading police on a high-speed chase.
Alicea, from Fitchburg, MA, was wanted for a February arson that displaced seven and injured one, per Worcester County warrant.
He faces multiple charges, including motor vehicle theft, reckless driving, and being a fugitive; held on $1 million bond.

title: Boston will be overflowing with Hobbits this weekend. Breakfast is involved.
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Hobbits from Peter Jackson's 'Lord of the Rings' film will celebrate the 25th anniversary at Fan Expo Boston Aug. 7-9.
Dominic Monaghan, Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, and Billy Boyd to host 'Second Breakfast' event at the convention.
'The Hunt for Gollum' directed by Andy Serkis is slated for a December 2027 release as part of LOTR film series.

title: These are the Mass. beaches closed for swimming as next potential heat wave moves in
author: Peter Chianca and Heather Alterisio
bullets: About 50 Massachusetts beaches were closed Thursday due to bacterial exceedance and harmful cyanobacteria blooms.
Beaches are monitored for bacteria levels by local health officials across over 1,100 public and semi-public sites.
The state's water quality dashboard is updated hourly during beach season to reflect current contamination status.

title: BPD releases photo of alleged boat burglars
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Boston Police seek public assistance to identify suspects in boat burglary at 63 Long Wharf.
Incident reported on July 10 involved stolen alcohol from a boat, investigation is ongoing.
Public can provide tips to District A-1 detectives or anonymously via Boston Police channels.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumes after former nanny’s testimony
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial resumes with witnesses testifying about her mental health and parenting.
Clancy is charged with first-degree murder for allegedly killing her three children in 2023.
Evidence includes testimony on Clancy's mental health medications and their levels during the incident.

title: 5 best new restaurant openings and dining updates in Boston (August 6, 2026)
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Happy Rice Sushi opens August with healthier sushi options at 2853 Boston Wharf Road in Seaport.
Harry Hare's brings British fine dining to Beacon Hill this fall, located at 149 Charles Street.
Jinjee offers Korean barbecue in Allston with dishes priced $45 to $90 per person at 161 Brighton Avenue.

title: Amid a tumultuous season, Jarren Duran is starting to take off at perfect time for Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox outfielder Jarren Duran improves performance, batting .341 in the last 12 games amid team winning streak.
Duran feared he would be released due to poor stats but is now contributing to Boston's strong second half.
Boston Red Sox have won nine consecutive series, boasting a 30-5 record over their last 35 games.

title: Suspect arrested in fatal shooting of Dorchester man
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Hensly Dominique Jeanty, 32, was arrested and charged with murder in the July shooting of Breidy Martinez, 29, in Dorchester.
Jeanty faces charges of discharging a firearm within 500 feet of a dwelling and carrying a loaded firearm without a license.
The incident occurred near 15 York St. in Dorchester, with police urging anyone with information to contact BPD detectives.

title: Worker killed after being pinned by tractor trailer at Mass. warehouse
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A 56-year-old man died after being pinned by a tractor trailer at a Wareham warehouse.
The incident occurred at Chatham Village Foods facility, reported at 9:45 a.m. Wednesday.
The investigation into the cause of the accident remains ongoing, according to the Plymouth County DA's office.
